Inside, rolled tight as a secret, a single page: 'To whoever finds this—I am alive, and I remember you.' The handwriting was his brother's, lost at sea before Elias ever took the light. He read it four times, then carried it up the spiral stair, where the great lens turned the night into spokes of gold. Below, the sea said nothing, as it always had. He set the message on the chart table beside his logbook, wrote the date, and added one line: 'Found. Reply pending.' Then he climbed to the lamp room and kept watch until dawn.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一头沉睡的巨兽。路灯昏黄，光落在空无一人的街道上。便利店的灯箱孤独闪烁，出租车偶尔驶过，车灯划破薄雾。写字楼几扇窗子仍透出微光，那是加班者的孤岛。环卫工人开始清扫昨日的喧嚣，早点铺的蒸笼冒出第一缕白汽。天边泛起淡淡的青色，鸟鸣零星。黎明前的城市最安静，仿佛悄悄换了一口气。", "w03": "• You do the small easy part of a problem, then hand the rest of it to a smaller copy of yourself.\n• That copy does its easy part and passes the rest along too, like opening nested gift boxes.\n• Eventually the piece left is so tiny it's already solved, and everyone passes the answer back up."}
